title: Enitor command reply
description: The reply to a command request (formats.md, section 2, Replies). Exactly one of result (ok true) or error (ok false). The shape of result depends on the command: add_task and complete_task return {task}, add_schedule_item returns {item}, list_today returns {date, tasks, schedule}; see task.schema.json and schedule-item.schema.json. Ping returns an empty result.

ok.description: true: result is present. false: error is present.

result.description: Command result. Its keys depend on the command, see the description above.

warnings.description: Unknown field names of the request. Empty when there are none.

code.description: Machine-readable error code. not_ready means Windows Enitor is still starting: repeat in a moment.

message.description: Human text in the app's language. Do not parse it.

field.description: The field that failed. Present for invalid_args.
